def _format_t(path, root=T):
    if root is T:
        buf = 'T'
    elif root is S:
        buf = 'S'
    elif root is A:
        buf = 'A'
    else:
        buf = repr(root)
    
    op_map = {
        '+': '+', '-': '-', '*': '*', '/': '/', '%': '%',
        ':': '**', '&': '&', '|': '|', '^': '^', '#': '//'
    }
    unary_map = {'~': '~', '_': '-'}
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(path):
        op = path[i]
        arg = path[i + 1]
        i += 2
        if op == '.':
            buf += '.' + arg
        elif op == '[':
            if type(arg) is tuple:
                buf += '[' + ', '.join(_format_slice(x) for x in arg) + ']'
            else:
                buf += '[' + _format_slice(arg) + ']'
        elif op == 'P':
            buf += '.' + repr(arg)
        elif op == '(':
            args, kwargs = arg
            parts = [bbrepr(a) for a in args]
            parts += [f'{k}={bbrepr(v)}' for k, v in kwargs.items()]
            buf += '(' + ', '.join(parts) + ')'
        elif op == 'x':
            buf += '.__star__()'
        elif op == 'X':
            buf += '.__starstar__()'
        elif op in op_map:
            sym = op_map[op]
            right = bbrepr(arg)
            # handle precedence with parens
            buf = buf + ' ' + sym + ' ' + right
        elif op in unary_map:
            sym = unary_map[op]
            buf = sym + '(' + buf + ')'
    
    return buf

            buf += '.' + arg
        elif op == '[':
            if type(arg) is tuple:
                buf += '[' + ', '.join(_format_slice(x) for x in arg) + ']'
            else:
                buf += '[' + _format_slice(arg) + ']'
        elif op == 'P':
            buf += '.' + repr(arg)
        elif op == '(':
            args, kwargs = arg
            parts = [bbrepr(a) for a in args]
            parts += [f'{k}={bbrepr(v)}' for k, v in kwargs.items()]
            buf += '(' + ', '.join(parts) + ')'
        elif op == 'x':
            buf += '.__star__()'
        elif op == 'X':
            buf += '.__starstar__()'
        elif op in op_symbols:
            sym = op_symbols[op]
            if isinstance(arg, TType) and len(arg.__ops__) > 1:
                right = '(' + bbrepr(arg) + ')'
            else:
                right = bbrepr(arg)
            buf = buf + ' ' + sym + ' ' + right
        elif op == '~':
            buf = '~' + buf
        elif op == '_':
            buf = '-(' + buf + ')'
    
    return buf
